review_notes: Six logical names: embed, embed_query, embed_passage, similarity, embedding_dim, supported_models. Three embedding functions have arity overloads; supported_models function and VIEW alias count once. No physical tables, COPY handlers, authenticated or write operations. Four advertised models are metadata, not proof of four working model runtimes; only pinned BGE-small-en-v1.5 runs. Current scalars.py and worker.py only add composed example SQL and agent-task metadata; full source diff reviewed and retained. Compute methods, supported-model registry, catalog registration/signatures, entrypoint and root dependencies are unchanged. The actual release catalog supports reviewed current-interface coverage, not an exact-current runtime claim.
